notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 40 layers x 10 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 204,800 B/token (200.0 KiB). head_dim absent from config.json: hidden_size 5120 / 40 attention heads = 128, the Phi-3/Phi-4-medium geometry. Uniform full attention, no sliding window; context_scaling null, so 32768 is native.
